additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0484008
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-AT SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2/U24002959696
Charger ID / Serial No.:
irCaBv
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason:
Regarding the issue reported with charger
Y2/U24002959696 / irCaBv
, after reviewing the error flags, we've determined that the problem is related to DC2. In this case, please check the following:
Go to the charger and verify components XD14.1, KF13, and QA32.
For QA32, confirm when the fast shutdown signal is active.
I send you a screenshot of the schematic to guide you during the inspection. Additionally, please ensure that the voltage between A1 and A2 is 24V.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-AT SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Ivan Perotto
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.

additional_info.body:
Hello Johannes,
If the fast shutdown is not running in DC3 and DC4 it's necessary to measure the signals to those groups, in order to understand where we are missing the signal.
Last information shared by my colleague is not correct but also the feedback from your activities is not. There is no QA32 in this charger.
Please check QA38 and QA40. In case support from my side is needed for the intervention send  me a TEAMS invitation.
